Here's your roadmap for the semester!

- {{< fa person-chalkboard >}} This will be a **standard lecture format** class
  with some in class participation.
- {{< fa laptop-code >}} This will be **active coding workshop** where we will
  work through a dataset (both as a class and in groups) to incorporate what we
  previously learned.
- {{< fa chalkboard-user >}} This will be an **in-person help-desk** where you can
  go and get help with a previously assigned practice worksheet with a tutor or
  to ask any questions about the course, the material, the exam, etc.
  - *You can also ask me any of this stuff too btw!*
- {{< fa pen-ruler >}} This will be a **graded Moodle quiz** that will take up a
  part of your continuous assessment.

```{r}
#| label: set-up
#| include: false

# Functions --------------------------------------------------------------------
source(here::here("R/build_schedule_table.R"))

# Packages ---------------------------------------------------------------------
library(dplyr)

# Class schedule
schedule <- readxl::read_xlsx(
  here::here("schedule/excel/schedule_st303.xlsx")
) |>
  build_schedule_table()
```

```{r}
#| label: create-tbl
#| echo: false
show_table <- function(schedule) {
  tbl <- schedule |>
    knitr::kable(
      format = "html",
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c(
        "Date",
        "Morning Topic",
        "Evening Topic",
        "Slides",
        "Coding",
        "Tutorial",
        "Assignment"
      ),
      table.attr = 'class="schedule-table"'
    ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling() |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      1,
      width = "10%",
      extra_css = "padding-right: 20px;"
    ) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(2:3, width = "30%") |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(4:7, width = "8%")

  return(cat(tbl))
}
```

## Class schedule

```{r}
#| label: show-tbl
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

show_table(schedule = schedule)
```
